Prep work space and load packages

```{r}
source("00_setup.R")
library(lme4)
library(splines)
library(glmmTMB)
library(car)
```

Load cleaned dataset

```{r}
utt_partners_emotions_merged <- readRDS( here("01Data","02Derived","FINAL_utt_RQ1_emotions_merged.rds") )

# Apply the same corpus exclusions as 02Demographics.qmd
EXCLUDE_CORPORA <- c("Feldman", "POLER-Controls", "Peters", "EllisWeismer")
utt_partners_emotions_merged <- utt_partners_emotions_merged %>%
  filter(!corpus_name %in% EXCLUDE_CORPORA)

file_lex <- read.csv("~/Desktop/R_WD/ThesisDataAnalysis/1987-Affectivelexicon-foundations_words.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE) 
emotion_words <-file_lex$Word
```

## Descriptive Stats Across all transcripts, how many times each words are used + frequency

```{r}

total_word_count <- utt_partners_emotions_merged %>%
  summarise(
    total_words = sum(str_count(gloss_lower, "\\b\\w+\\b"))
  ) %>%
  pull(total_words)

total_emotion_words_merged <- utt_partners_emotions_merged %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(emotion_words), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
   emotion_count = sum(emotion_count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"
  )

emotion_counts_long_merged <- total_emotion_words_merged %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "word",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    freq_per_1000_words = (count / total_word_count) * 1000
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(freq_per_1000_words))

emotion_counts_long_merged

write.csv(
  emotion_counts_long_merged, here("03Output", "MERGED emotion word count and frequency.csv" )
 ,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

By Role

```{r}
total_emotion_words_by_role_merged <- utt_partners_emotions_merged %>%
  group_by(role_category) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(emotion_words), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    emotion_count = sum(emotion_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

total_word_count_by_role_merged <- utt_partners_emotions_merged %>%
  mutate(word_count = str_count(gloss_lower, "\\b\\w+\\b")) %>%
  group_by(role_category) %>%
  summarise(
    total_words = sum(word_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

emotion_counts_long_by_role_merged <- total_emotion_words_by_role_merged %>%
  left_join(total_word_count_by_role_merged, by = "role_category") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(role_category, total_words),
    names_to = "word",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    freq_per_1000_words = (count / total_words) * 1000
  ) %>%
  arrange(role_category, desc(freq_per_1000_words))

total_emotion_counts_long_by_role_merged <- emotion_counts_long_by_role_merged %>%
  filter(
    word == "emotion_count"
  ) %>%
  select(role_category, count, freq_per_1000_words) %>%
  mutate(
    count_hundreds        = round(count / 100, 1),
    freq_per_1000_words   = round(freq_per_1000_words, 2)
  )
total_emotion_counts_long_by_role_merged

# Overall rate across all roles
overall_rate <- emotion_counts_long_by_role_merged %>%
  filter(word == "emotion_count") %>%
  summarise(
    total_count = sum(count),
    total_words = sum(total_words),
    overall_rate_per_1000 = round(total_count / total_words * 1000, 2)
  )
overall_rate

write.csv(
  total_emotion_counts_long_by_role_merged %>%
    select(role_category, count_hundreds, freq_per_1000_words),
  here("03Output", "emotion word count and frequency_by role.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

Prep Dataset for RQ1

```{r}
utt_model_df <- utt_partners_emotions_merged %>%
  select(
    # identifiers
    id,
    target_child_id,
    speaker_id,
    corpus_id,
    corpus_name,
    transcript_id,

    # predictors
    role_category,
    target_child_age,
    target_child_sex,

    # outcome / exposure
    emotion_count,
    num_tokens
  )

# --- Missing data diagnostics ---
# How many unique transcripts are affected by each source of missingness?
n_total <- n_distinct(utt_model_df$transcript_id)

miss_diag <- utt_model_df %>%
  distinct(transcript_id, target_child_age, target_child_sex) %>%
  summarise(
    n_transcripts        = n_distinct(transcript_id),
    missing_age          = sum(is.na(target_child_age)),
    missing_sex          = sum(is.na(target_child_sex)),
    missing_age_only     = sum( is.na(target_child_age) & !is.na(target_child_sex)),
    missing_sex_only     = sum(!is.na(target_child_age) &  is.na(target_child_sex)),
    missing_both         = sum( is.na(target_child_age) &  is.na(target_child_sex)),
    pct_missing_age      = round(mean(is.na(target_child_age)) * 100, 1),
    pct_missing_sex      = round(mean(is.na(target_child_sex)) * 100, 1)
  )
print(miss_diag)

# Which corpora drive the missingness?
miss_by_corpus <- utt_model_df %>%
  distinct(transcript_id, corpus_name, target_child_age, target_child_sex) %>%
  group_by(corpus_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n          = n(),
    pct_miss_age = round(mean(is.na(target_child_age)) * 100, 1),
    pct_miss_sex = round(mean(is.na(target_child_sex)) * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(pct_miss_age > 0 | pct_miss_sex > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_miss_sex))
print(miss_by_corpus)

# Retain all transcripts with at least 1 token.
# Missing age and sex are kept as-is; models drop incomplete rows automatically.
# Sex is coded "unknown" rather than NA so those transcripts still enter the model.
utt_model_df_rq1 <- utt_model_df %>%
  filter(num_tokens > 0) %>%
  mutate(target_child_sex = replace_na(target_child_sex, "unknown"))

cat(sprintf("Transcripts in model dataset: %d\n",
            n_distinct(utt_model_df_rq1$transcript_id)))
cat(sprintf("  missing age: %d\n",
            sum(is.na(distinct(utt_model_df_rq1, transcript_id, target_child_age)$target_child_age)))
)
cat(sprintf("  sex unknown: %d\n",
            sum(distinct(utt_model_df_rq1, transcript_id, target_child_sex)$target_child_sex == "unknown"))
)

```

### Sex distribution of target children in model dataset

```{r sex-distribution}
# One row per unique child (not per transcript) to avoid double-counting
sex_dist <- utt_model_df_rq1 %>%
  distinct(target_child_id, target_child_sex) %>%
  count(target_child_sex, name = "n_children") %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n_children / sum(n_children) * 100, 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_children))

print(sex_dist)

# Also at transcript level (children contribute multiple transcripts)
sex_dist_tr <- utt_model_df_rq1 %>%
  distinct(transcript_id, target_child_sex) %>%
  count(target_child_sex, name = "n_transcripts") %>%
  mutate(pct = round(n_transcripts / sum(n_transcripts) * 100, 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_transcripts))

cat("\nBy transcript:\n")
print(sex_dist_tr)
```

## RQ1a. Environmental input vs. target child — aggregate trajectory

Collapse all non-target-child speakers into a single "Environmental Input" category and compare its emotion-word trajectory to the target child's trajectory across age. This gives a two-line summary: how the child's input environment as a whole tracks alongside the child's own production.

```{r rq1a-data}
df_tr_env <- utt_model_df_rq1 %>%
  mutate(role_env = if_else(role_category == "Target Child",
                            "Target Child", "Environmental Input")) %>%
  group_by(transcript_id, corpus_name, target_child_id,
           role_env, target_child_age, target_child_sex) %>%
  summarise(
    emotion_count = sum(emotion_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    num_tokens    = sum(num_tokens,    na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(num_tokens > 0) %>%
  mutate(role_env = relevel(factor(role_env), ref = "Environmental Input"))
```

```{r rq1a-model}
m_env <- glmmTMB(
  emotion_count ~
    role_env * ns(target_child_age, df = 3) +
    target_child_sex +
    offset(log(num_tokens)) +
    (1 | corpus_name/target_child_id/transcript_id),
  family = nbinom2(),
  data   = df_tr_env
)
summary(m_env)
```

```{r rq1a-wald}
# ── Joint Wald tests: Environmental Input and Target Child age trajectories ────
# Environmental Input is the reference group, so its trajectory = spline main effects.
# Target Child trajectory = spline main effects + role_envTarget Child:spline interactions.

coef_env  <- fixef(m_env)$cond
vcov_env  <- vcov(m_env)$cond
sp_env    <- grep("^ns\\(target_child_age", names(coef_env), value = TRUE)

wald_env <- lapply(c("Environmental Input", "Target Child"), function(role) {
  n  <- length(coef_env)
  H  <- matrix(0, nrow = 3, ncol = n,
               dimnames = list(paste0("spline_", 1:3), names(coef_env)))
  for (j in seq_along(sp_env)) {
    H[j, sp_env[j]] <- 1
    if (role == "Target Child") {
      int_name       <- paste0("role_envTarget Child:", sp_env[j])
      H[j, int_name] <- 1
    }
  }
  lh <- car::linearHypothesis(m_env, hypothesis.matrix = H,
                               coef. = coef_env, vcov. = vcov_env)
  data.frame(
    role    = role,
    chi_sq  = round(lh$Chisq[2], 3),
    df      = lh$Df[2],
    p_value = round(lh[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][2], 4)
  )
})

env_wald_tests <- do.call(rbind, wald_env)
rownames(env_wald_tests) <- NULL
cat("\nJoint Wald tests — Environmental Input vs Target Child age trajectories:\n")
print(env_wald_tests)
```

```{r rq1a-plot}
age_seq_m <- seq(min(df_tr_env$target_child_age, na.rm = TRUE),
                 max(df_tr_env$target_child_age, na.rm = TRUE),
                 by = 1.2)   # ~0.1-year steps in months

new_env <- expand.grid(
  target_child_age = age_seq_m,
  role_env         = levels(df_tr_env$role_env),
  target_child_sex = names(which.max(table(df_tr_env$target_child_sex))),
  num_tokens       = 1000
)
new_env$role_env <- factor(new_env$role_env, levels = levels(df_tr_env$role_env))

pred_env <- predict(m_env, newdata = new_env,
                    type = "link", se.fit = TRUE, re.form = NA)
new_env$fit      <- exp(pred_env$fit)
new_env$ci_lower <- exp(pred_env$fit - 1.96 * pred_env$se.fit)
new_env$ci_upper <- exp(pred_env$fit + 1.96 * pred_env$se.fit)
new_env$age_yrs  <- new_env$target_child_age / 12

p_env <- ggplot(new_env, aes(x = age_yrs, y = fit,
                              colour = role_env, fill = role_env)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper),
              alpha = 0.2, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(
    data      = subset(new_env, role_env == "Target Child"),
    linewidth = 1.8
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data      = subset(new_env, role_env != "Target Child"),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name   = NULL,
    values = c("Target Child"       = "#e05c3a",
               "Environmental Input" = "#4a90d9")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name   = NULL,
    values = c("Target Child"       = "#e05c3a",
               "Environmental Input" = "#4a90d9")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 12, by = 1),
                     limits = range(new_env$age_yrs)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 25)) +
  labs(
    title = "Emotion Word Use: Target Child vs. Aggregated Environmental Input",
    x     = "Child age (years)",
    y     = "Expected count per 1,000 words"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_env)

ggsave(
  filename = here::here("03Output", "RQ1a_env_vs_child_trajectory.png"),
  plot     = p_env,
  width    = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300
)

# Predicted rates at key ages (for write-up)
target_ages_yrs <- c(0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 12)

rates_env <- do.call(rbind, lapply(target_ages_yrs, function(a) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(new_env$role_env), function(role) {
    d   <- new_env[new_env$role_env == role, ]
    idx <- which.min(abs(d$age_yrs - a))
    data.frame(
      role        = role,
      age_yrs     = round(d$age_yrs[idx], 2),
      fit         = round(d$fit[idx], 2),
      ci_lower    = round(d$ci_lower[idx], 2),
      ci_upper    = round(d$ci_upper[idx], 2)
    )
  }))
}))

cat("\nPredicted rates at key ages (per 1,000 words):\n")
print(rates_env)
```

## Raw mean rate per 1,000 words — Environmental Input vs Target Child (from df_tr_env)

```{r raw-means-rq1a}
df_tr_env %>%
  mutate(rate_per_1000 = (emotion_count / num_tokens) * 1000) %>%
  group_by(role_env) %>%
  summarise(
    n_transcripts = n(),
    n_children    = n_distinct(target_child_id),
    age_min_yrs   = round(min(target_child_age,  na.rm = TRUE) / 12, 1),
    age_max_yrs   = round(max(target_child_age,  na.rm = TRUE) / 12, 1),
    mean_age_yrs  = round(mean(target_child_age, na.rm = TRUE) / 12, 1),
    mean_rate     = round(mean(rate_per_1000,    na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    median_rate   = round(median(rate_per_1000,  na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd_rate       = round(sd(rate_per_1000,      na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_rate)) %>%
  print(width = Inf)
```

## RQ1b. Developmental trajectories by conversational partner role

### prep transcript-level dataset

```{r}
transcript_id <- "transcript_id"

df_tr <- utt_model_df_rq1 %>%
  group_by(
    !!sym(transcript_id),
    corpus_name,
    target_child_id,
    role_category,
    target_child_age,
    target_child_sex
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    emotion_count = sum(emotion_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    num_tokens    = sum(num_tokens, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(num_tokens > 0)

df_tr <- df_tr %>%
    mutate(role_category = relevel(factor(role_category), ref = "Mother"))

m_tr_nb <- glmmTMB(
  emotion_count ~
    role_category * ns(target_child_age, df = 3) +
    target_child_sex +
    offset(log(num_tokens)) +
    (1 | corpus_name/target_child_id/transcript_id),
  family = nbinom2(),
  data = df_tr
)
summary(m_tr_nb)
```

### prediction and plotting

```{r}
# observed age range
age_min_m <- min(df_tr$target_child_age, na.rm = TRUE)
age_max_m <- max(df_tr$target_child_age, na.rm = TRUE)
age_min_y <- age_min_m / 12
age_max_y <- age_max_m / 12

age_years  <- seq(age_min_y, age_max_y, by = 0.1) #sequence of age by 0.1 years 
age_months <- age_years * 12

role_levels <- sort(unique(df_tr$role_category))
sex_levels  <- sort(unique(df_tr$target_child_sex))
ref_sex     <- sex_levels[1]

new_data <- expand.grid( #build grid of all possible combinations 
  target_child_age = age_months,
  role_category = role_levels,
  target_child_sex = ref_sex,
  num_tokens = 1000 #sets offset
)

#convert to factors and match original model
new_data$role_category    <- factor(new_data$role_category, levels = role_levels)
new_data$target_child_sex <- factor(new_data$target_child_sex, levels = sex_levels)
new_data$target_child_age_years <- new_data$target_child_age / 12

pred <- predict(
  m_tr_nb,
  newdata = new_data,
  type = "link",
  se.fit = TRUE,
  re.form = NA
)

#transforming results 
new_data$fit_link <- pred$fit
new_data$se_link  <- pred$se.fit
new_data$fit      <- exp(new_data$fit_link)
new_data$ci_lower <- exp(new_data$fit_link - 1.96 * new_data$se_link)
new_data$ci_upper <- exp(new_data$fit_link + 1.96 * new_data$se_link)

#transform target child as the first in the legend 
new_data <- new_data %>%
  mutate(
    role_category = factor(
      role_category,
      levels = c(
        "Target Child",
        "Known Adult",
        "Mother",
        "Other Adult",
        "Father",
        "Other Child",
        "Sibling"
      ))
    )

#plotting all social partners 
p <- ggplot(new_data,
            aes(x = target_child_age_years, y = fit,
                color = role_category, fill = role_category)) +
  geom_line(
    data = subset(new_data, role_category == "Target Child"),
    linewidth = 1.8
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = subset(new_data, role_category != "Target Child"),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper),
              alpha = 0.2, colour = NA) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 12, by = 1),
    limits = c(age_min_y, age_max_y)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 25)) +
  labs(
    title = "Emotion Words by Speaker and Child Age",
    x = "Age (years)",
    y = "Expected Count Per 1,000 Words"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name = "Partner type",
    values = c(
      "Target Child" = "#e05c3a",
      "Mother" = "#57b403",
      "Father" = "#a58aff",
      "Sibling" = "#fb61d7",
      "Known Adult" = "#c59a00",
      "Other Adult" = "#06b6eb",
      "Other Child" = "#a6a6a6"
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Partner type",
    values = c(
      "Target Child" = "#e05c3a",
      "Mother" = "#57b403",
      "Father" = "#a58aff",
      "Sibling" = "#fb61d7",
      "Known Adult" = "#c59a00",
      "Other Adult" = "#06b6eb",
      "Other Child" = "#a6a6a6"
    )
  )
print(p)
```

## Joint Wald Tests — Each Partner's Own Age Trajectory

For each role, tests H0: the three age-spline terms for that role are jointly zero (i.e., the role's own trajectory across child age is flat).

For Target Child (reference): tests the three spline main effects. For all other roles: tests (spline_j + role:spline_j) = 0 jointly for j = 1,2,3.

```{r}
coef_fe <- fixef(m_tr_nb)$cond
vcov_fe <- vcov(m_tr_nb)$cond

# Spline main-effect names
sp_names <- grep("^ns\\(target_child_age", names(coef_fe), value = TRUE)
cat("Spline main effects:\n"); print(sp_names)

# All roles — Mother is reference, listed first; its test uses spline main effects only
roles <- c("Mother", "Father", "Known Adult", "Target Child",
           "Other Adult", "Other Child", "Sibling")

# Sanity check: verify interaction names exist for each non-reference role
cat("\nInteraction term existence check:\n")
for (r in roles[-1]) {
  int_terms <- paste0("role_category", r, ":", sp_names)
  found     <- int_terms %in% names(coef_fe)
  cat(sprintf("  %-15s : %s\n", r, paste(ifelse(found, "OK", "MISSING"), collapse = " ")))
}

# Build contrast matrix and run test for each role
wald_results <- lapply(roles, function(role) {
  n_coef     <- length(coef_fe)
  coef_names <- names(coef_fe)

  H <- matrix(0, nrow = 3, ncol = n_coef,
              dimnames = list(paste0("spline_", 1:3), coef_names))

  for (j in seq_along(sp_names)) {
    H[j, sp_names[j]] <- 1                                  # spline main effect
    if (role != "Mother") {
      int_name          <- paste0("role_category", role, ":", sp_names[j])
      H[j, int_name]    <- 1                                 # add interaction
    }
  }

  lh     <- linearHypothesis(m_tr_nb, hypothesis.matrix = H,
                              coef. = coef_fe, vcov. = vcov_fe)
  chi_sq <- lh$Chisq[2]
  df_val <- lh$Df[2]
  p_val  <- lh[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][2]

  data.frame(role    = role,
             chi_sq  = round(chi_sq, 3),
             df      = df_val,
             p_value = round(p_val, 4),
             is_reference = role == "Mother",
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})

traj_tests <- do.call(rbind, wald_results)
rownames(traj_tests) <- NULL

cat("\nJoint Wald tests — own age trajectory per role:\n")
print(traj_tests)

write.csv(traj_tests,
          here::here("03Output", "rq1_partner_trajectory_joint_tests.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nSaved: 03Output/rq1_partner_trajectory_joint_tests.csv\n")
```

## Predicted Rates at Key Ages and Peak/Trough Detection

```{r}
# ── 1. Predicted rates at fixed ages ──────────────────────────────────────────
target_ages <- c(0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 12)

# For each role × target age, find the row in new_data closest to that age
rates_at_ages <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
  levels(new_data$role_category),
  function(role) {
    d <- new_data[new_data$role_category == role, ]
    do.call(rbind, lapply(target_ages, function(a) {
      idx <- which.min(abs(d$target_child_age_years - a))
      data.frame(
        role      = role,
        age_years = round(d$target_child_age_years[idx], 2),
        fit       = round(d$fit[idx],      2),
        ci_lower  = round(d$ci_lower[idx], 2),
        ci_upper  = round(d$ci_upper[idx], 2),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }))
  }
))
rownames(rates_at_ages) <- NULL

cat("=== Predicted rates at key ages ===\n")
print(rates_at_ages)

write.csv(rates_at_ages,
          here::here("03Output", "rq1_predicted_rates_at_key_ages.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: 03Output/rq1_predicted_rates_at_key_ages.csv\n\n")

# ── 2. Peak and trough per role ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Trough excludes the two endpoints (first and last age point per role)
peak_trough <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
  levels(new_data$role_category),
  function(role) {
    d        <- new_data[new_data$role_category == role, ]
    d        <- d[order(d$target_child_age_years), ]
    fit_vals <- d$fit
    age_vals <- d$target_child_age_years
    n        <- nrow(d)

    range_fit <- max(fit_vals) - min(fit_vals)

    # Shape classification
    if (range_fit < 1) {
      shape <- "approximately flat"
    } else {
      is_monotone_inc <- all(diff(fit_vals) >= -0.01)
      is_monotone_dec <- all(diff(fit_vals) <=  0.01)
      if      (is_monotone_inc) shape <- "monotonic increase"
      else if (is_monotone_dec) shape <- "monotonic decrease"
      else {
        # Determine if U-shape, inverted U, or complex by checking interior
        interior_max_idx <- which.max(fit_vals[2:(n-1)]) + 1
        interior_min_idx <- which.min(fit_vals[2:(n-1)]) + 1
        # U-shape: interior min is much lower than both endpoints
        # Inverted U: interior max is much higher than both endpoints
        end_mean <- mean(c(fit_vals[1], fit_vals[n]))
        if (fit_vals[interior_max_idx] > end_mean + 0.5 * range_fit) {
          shape <- "inverted U"
        } else if (fit_vals[interior_min_idx] < end_mean - 0.5 * range_fit) {
          shape <- "U-shape"
        } else {
          shape <- "complex"
        }
      }
    }

    # Peak: global max
    peak_idx      <- which.max(fit_vals)
    peak_age      <- round(age_vals[peak_idx], 2)
    peak_fit_val  <- round(fit_vals[peak_idx], 2)

    # Trough: interior minimum (exclude endpoints); NA if flat or monotonic
    if (shape %in% c("approximately flat", "monotonic increase", "monotonic decrease")) {
      trough_age     <- NA_real_
      trough_fit_val <- NA_real_
    } else {
      interior_idx   <- 2:(n - 1)
      trough_idx     <- interior_idx[which.min(fit_vals[interior_idx])]
      trough_age     <- round(age_vals[trough_idx], 2)
      trough_fit_val <- round(fit_vals[trough_idx], 2)
    }

    data.frame(
      role            = role,
      peak_age_years  = peak_age,
      peak_fit        = peak_fit_val,
      trough_age_years = trough_age,
      trough_fit      = trough_fit_val,
      shape_note      = shape,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
))
rownames(peak_trough) <- NULL

cat("=== Peak and trough per role ===\n")
print(peak_trough)

# Sanity check: flag near-flat roles
flat_roles <- peak_trough$role[peak_trough$shape_note == "approximately flat"]
if (length(flat_roles) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\nNote: the following roles have range < 1/1000 words (approx. flat): %s\n",
              paste(flat_roles, collapse = ", ")))
}

# Sanity check: Mother endpoint values
m_low  <- rates_at_ages$fit[rates_at_ages$role == "Mother" & rates_at_ages$age_years == 0.5]
m_high <- rates_at_ages$fit[rates_at_ages$role == "Mother" & rates_at_ages$age_years == 12]
cat(sprintf("\nSanity check — Mother predicted rate:\n  at 0.5 yr: %.2f/1000  |  at 12 yr: %.2f/1000\n",
            m_low, m_high))

write.csv(peak_trough,
          here::here("03Output", "rq1_peak_trough_by_role.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: 03Output/rq1_peak_trough_by_role.csv\n")
```

## Raw mean rate per 1,000 words by partner role (from df_tr)

```{r raw-means-by-role}
df_tr %>%
  group_by(role_category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_transcripts = n(),
    n_children    = n_distinct(target_child_id),
    age_min_yrs   = round(min(target_child_age,  na.rm = TRUE) / 12, 1),
    age_max_yrs   = round(max(target_child_age,  na.rm = TRUE) / 12, 1),
    mean_age_yrs  = round(mean(target_child_age, na.rm = TRUE) / 12, 1),
    mean_rate     = round(mean(rate_per_1000,    na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    median_rate   = round(median(rate_per_1000,  na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd_rate       = round(sd(rate_per_1000,      na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_rate)) %>%
  print(width = Inf)
```
